title: Name and fix the load failures of the bases and browser gauntlet cases
goal: nerv-system-flows/bases and nerv-system-flows/browser pass under machine load as they do alone
acceptance: The failure of each case under load is reproduced and its cause named from the run output
A regression that reproduces the load case fails before the fix and passes after it
Both cases pass under the same load after the fix, or the case states the bound that absorbs it
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: npm run gauntlet:run (the two cases, under load and alone, owner-approved where it calls models)
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 from the owner's report: reproduce under load, name the cause, fix, rerun both cases. Not a measurement. Closed 2026-11-24 in the reconciliation: PR #710 merged on green CI; both gauntlet cases passed under load and alone.
